title: Gyro Ke Bina Ye Robot Turant Gir Jaata 🤖 #shorts
description:
Ye robot gir kyun nahi raha? Raaz gyro, filter aur PID mein hai!
🤖 Gyro sirf rotation rate naapta hai, angle nahi
🧮 Complementary filter gyro aur accelerometer ko blend karta hai
⚙️ PID angle error ko motor speed banata hai
📡 FC-51 IR sensor deewar detect karta hai, balance nahi sambhalta
Subscribe karo aur aise 3D explainers dekhte raho!
